title: Delinquency bucket ladder over days past due

scope_out: must not compute or charge a late fee, penal interest or any lateness charge; must not read or write loan state — the classifier stays pure; must not introduce a sixth bucket or an orthogonal NPA flag, per D3

entities.name: Delinquency bucket ladder over days past due

operations.text:
1. Define the DPD floor boundaries as Config-layer constants in `backend/src/config/delinquency.py` (new): CURRENT 0-29, DPD-30 30-59, DPD-60 60-89, DPD-90 90-179, NPA 180 or more, per D-B/D3.
2. Define the `DelinquencyBucket` enum (five members, no sixth bucket, no orthogonal NPA flag) and a pure `classify(days_past_due: int) -> DelinquencyBucket` function in `backend/src/types/delinquency.py` (new), reading the floors from `backend/src/config/delinquency.py`; the function reads and writes no loan state and returns a bucket only.
3. Add boundary and full-range tests in `backend/tests/unit/test_bucket_ladder.py` (new): the 35-day case (AC1), an exhaustive 0-400 sweep with no gap/overlap (AC2), the CURRENT/no-installment-past-due case (AC3), and an assertion that the result carries no fee/interest/charge field (AC4).
